stages.reference: Create a close material reference for weathered spruce planks used in a cold grounded dark-fantasy settlement. The boards should carry long straight conifer grain, small knots, subtle resin streaks and hand-sawn irregularity. Cold dry air has dulled the wood toward muted tan and gray-brown, while sheltered seams retain warmer resinous tones. Wear should polish fibers selectively rather than flattening all detail. Avoid orange pine furniture, perfectly clean construction lumber, glossy varnish, exaggerated knots or uniform gray barn wood. Establish a practical cold-climate timber language: straight-grained, resinous, modest, weathered and lighter than dark oak.
